name: Joachim Streit - § 8 - Am 4
title: REPORT on the financial activities of the European Investment Bank Group – annual report 2025
part_text: 8. Calls on the Commission to urgently present, by 31 August 2028, a proposal to extend the Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF) implementation period so the full amount of its funding can be used; calls on the EIB to play an active role in supporting the continuity and completion of projects beyond the new cut-off date should it prove necessary after the extension; underlines that EIB financing and technical assistance can provide an additional bridge to ensure that RRF-funded projects deliver their intended economic and social impact;
